import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current
from polib import (measure, grasp_candidate, as_target, pose7_shift, jaw_pixel,
                   project_uv, APPR)

ARM = "right"; CAM = "right_wrist"; UV = [448, 404]
POS_TOL = 0.010
Z_DROP = 0.002

def mv(tgt, **kw):
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: tgt}, **kw)
    if not r.ok:
        handoff("move failed", status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code,
                err=r.target_error_m, summary=r.summary)
    return r

obs0 = current()
m = measure(CAM, UV)
if m is None:
    handoff("target block not segmented", cam=CAM, uv=UV)
l2 = measure("head", [236, 218])
bl = measure("head", [320, 283])
if l2 is None or bl is None:
    handoff("layout references not segmented", l2=l2 is not None, bl=bl is not None)

table_z = float(l2["support_z"])
x_left = float(l2["aabb_center"][0]); y_c = float(l2["aabb_center"][1])
half_blk_x = 0.5 * float(l2["extent"][0])
half_sep = 0.5 * float(bl["extent"][0]) - half_blk_x - 0.020
x_right = x_left + 2 * half_sep
x_c = x_left + half_sep
print("layout: table_z=%.4f x_left=%.4f y_c=%.4f half_sep=%.4f x_right=%.4f x_c=%.4f" %
      (table_z, x_left, y_c, half_sep, x_right, x_c))
print("target block rest: aabb", np.round(m["lo"],4).tolist(), np.round(m["hi"],4).tolist(),
      "thick", round(m["thickness"],4))

cands = grasp_candidate(m["target_ref"], ARM)
if not cands:
    handoff("no reachable grasp candidate", n=0)
c = cands[0]
print("grasp cand", c["candidate_id"], "opening", c["gripper_opening_m"],
      "ik", (c["ik_reachability"] or {}).get("member"))
mv(as_target(c["pregrasp_pose"], "free_space"), speed="fast")
mv(as_target(c["contact_pose"], "precision"), slow_approaching=True)
rg = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "close"}, target_ref=m["target_ref"])
if not rg.ok:
    handoff("close failed", status=rg.status, failure=rg.failure_code)
print("close:", rg.status, rg.failure_code, "opening", rg.measured_opening)
mv(as_target(pose7_shift(c["contact_pose"], [0, 0, 0.040]), "precision"))

obs1 = current()
jp = jaw_pixel(obs1, CAM, ARM)
held = measure(CAM, jp)
if held is None:
    handoff("held object not visible in wrist camera", jaw_px=jp)
print("held: aabb", np.round(held["lo"],4).tolist(), np.round(held["hi"],4).tolist(),
      "ext", np.round(held["extent"],4).tolist())
link = np.array(obs1.pose(ARM).position.xyz, float)
dxy = held["aabb_center"][:2] - link[:2]
zb_off = link[2] - float(held["lo"][2])
t_held = float(held["hi"][2] - held["lo"][2])
print("link6", np.round(link,4).tolist(), "dxy", np.round(dxy,4).tolist(),
      "zb_off", round(zb_off,4), "t_held", round(t_held,4))
if np.max(np.abs(dxy)) > 0.02 or zb_off > 0.20 or zb_off < 0.10:
    handoff("held-object geometry implausible", dxy=dxy.tolist(), zb_off=zb_off, t=t_held)

q = c["contact_pose"]["orientation_xyzw"]
z_place = table_z + Z_DROP
link_t = [float(x_right - dxy[0]), float(y_c - dxy[1]), float(z_place + zb_off)]
print("place link6 target", np.round(link_t, 4).tolist())
mv(as_target(pose7_shift({"position_m": link_t, "orientation_xyzw": q}, [0, 0, 0.06]),
             "free_space"), speed="normal", exact_orientation=True)
mv(as_target({"position_m": link_t, "orientation_xyzw": q}, "precision"),
   speed="normal", slow_approaching=True, exact_orientation=True)
rop = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM: "open"})
if not rop.ok:
    handoff("open failed", status=rop.status, failure=rop.failure_code)
mv(as_target(pose7_shift({"position_m": link_t, "orientation_xyzw": q}, [0, 0, 0.08]),
             "precision"), speed="normal")

obs2 = current()
exp = np.array([x_right, y_c, table_z + 0.5 * t_held])
uv, w = project_uv("head", exp)
ver = measure("head", uv) if uv else None
if ver is None:
    handoff("placed block not seen in head view", exp_uv=uv, exp=exp.tolist())
err = ver["aabb_center"] - exp
print("VERIFY placed block:", np.round(ver["aabb_center"],4).tolist(),
      "target", np.round(exp,4).tolist(), "err_xy", np.round(err[:2],4).tolist(),
      "top_z", round(float(ver["hi"][2]),4), "bot_z", round(float(ver["lo"][2]),4))
if float(np.max(np.abs(err[:2]))) > POS_TOL:
    handoff("placement outside tolerance", err_xy=err[:2].tolist(), tol=POS_TOL)
print("OK cycle lower-right support placed")

import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, handoff
from ora_lib import current
from polib import measure, project_uv, pick_place

ARM="left"; WRIST="left_wrist"
SUP_R_PREV = [0.0815, -0.0523, 0.7845]   # measured last step (observation-0007)

obs = current()
l2 = measure("head", [236, 218])
uvr, w = project_uv("head", SUP_R_PREV)
rb = measure("head", uvr) if uvr else None
bl = measure("head", [320, 283])
if l2 is None or rb is None or bl is None:
    handoff("references missing", l2=l2 is not None, rb=rb is not None, bl=bl is not None)
print("L2", np.round(l2["aabb_center"],4).tolist(), "top", round(float(l2["hi"][2]),4))
print("SR", np.round(rb["aabb_center"],4).tolist(), "top", round(float(rb["hi"][2]),4))
print("BL", np.round(bl["aabb_center"],4).tolist(), "lo", round(float(bl["lo"][2]),4), "hi", round(float(bl["hi"][2]),4))

z_support = max(float(l2["hi"][2]), float(rb["hi"][2]))
x_mid = 0.5*(float(l2["aabb_center"][0]) + float(rb["aabb_center"][0]))
y_mid = 0.5*(float(l2["aabb_center"][1]) + float(rb["aabb_center"][1]))
print("target board centre xy", round(x_mid,4), round(y_mid,4), "z_support", round(z_support,4))

res = pick_place(bl, ARM, WRIST, [x_mid, y_mid], z_support, label="boardL")
print("RESULT", json.dumps({k:(v if k not in ("verify",) else None) for k,v in res.items() if k!="verify_uv"}, default=str))
v = res["verify"]
print("placed boardL aabb", np.round(v["lo"],4).tolist(), np.round(v["hi"],4).tolist(),
      "err_xy", np.round(res["err_xy"],4).tolist())

from robot import handoff as _handoff

def pick_place(m, arm, wrist_cam, target_xy, z_support, *, drop=0.002, tol=0.012,
               lift_m=0.040, approach_up=0.060, retract=0.100, rotate_deg=None,
               verify_cam="head", label="", lateral_max_extent=0.10, exact=True):
    res = {"label": label}
    if m is None:
        _handoff("object not segmented", label=label)
    cands = grasp_candidate(m["target_ref"], arm)
    if not cands:
        _handoff("no reachable grasp candidate", label=label)
    c = cands[0]
    res["cand"] = {k: c.get(k) for k in ("candidate_id", "gripper_opening_m")}
    for tgt, kw in ((as_target(c["pregrasp_pose"], "free_space"), dict(speed="fast")),
                    (as_target(c["contact_pose"], "precision"), dict(slow_approaching=True))):
        r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: tgt}, **kw)
        if not r.ok:
            _handoff("grasp move failed", label=label, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
    rg = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "close"}, target_ref=m["target_ref"])
    if not stall_ok(rg):
        _handoff("close failed", label=label, status=rg.status, failure=rg.failure_code)
    res["close"] = (rg.status, rg.failure_code, rg.measured_opening)
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: as_target(pose7_shift(c["contact_pose"], [0, 0, lift_m]), "precision")})
    if not r.ok:
        _handoff("lift failed", label=label, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
    if rotate_deg is not None:
        rr = tools.rotate_wrist(targets={arm: rotate_deg}, exact_orientation=True)
        if not rr.ok:
            _handoff("rotate failed", label=label, status=rr.status, failure=rr.failure_code)
    obs1 = current()
    held, jp = held_measure(arm, wrist_cam, obs1)
    if held is None:
        _handoff("held object not visible in wrist camera", label=label, jaw_px=jp)
    link = np.array(obs1.pose(arm).position.xyz, float)
    q = np.array(obs1.pose(arm).xyzw, float)
    dxy = np.array(held["aabb_center"][:2], float) - link[:2]
    corr = np.array([dxy[i] if float(m["extent"][i]) < lateral_max_extent else 0.0 for i in (0, 1)])
    res["dxy"] = dxy; res["corr"] = corr
    res["held_ext"] = held["extent"].tolist()
    if float(np.max(np.abs(dxy))) > 0.03:
        _handoff("held offset implausible", label=label, dxy=dxy.tolist())
    contact = np.array(c["contact_pose"]["position_m"], float)
    dz = (z_support + drop) - float(m["lo"][2])
    link_place = np.array([target_xy[0] - corr[0], target_xy[1] - corr[1], contact[2] + dz], float)
    res["link_place"] = link_place.tolist()
    above = link_place + np.array([0, 0, approach_up])
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: mk_target(above, quat=q, interaction="free_space")},
                        speed="normal", exact_orientation=exact)
    if not r.ok:
        _handoff("move above place failed", label=label, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: mk_target(link_place, quat=q, interaction="precision")},
                        speed="normal", slow_approaching=True, exact_orientation=exact)
    if not r.ok:
        _handoff("move down to place failed", label=label, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
    res["down_err"] = r.target_error_m
    rop = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
    if not rop.ok:
        _handoff("open failed", label=label, status=rop.status, failure=rop.failure_code)
    up = link_place + np.array([0, 0, retract])
    r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: mk_target(up, quat=q, interaction="precision")}, speed="normal")
    if not r.ok:
        _handoff("retract failed", label=label, status=r.status, failure=r.failure_code)
    obs2 = current()
    t_obj = float(m["hi"][2] - m["lo"][2])
    vp = [target_xy[0], target_xy[1], z_support + min(0.5 * t_obj, 0.006)]
    uv2, w = project_uv(verify_cam, vp)
    ver = measure(verify_cam, uv2) if uv2 else None
    res["verify_uv"] = uv2
    if ver is None:
        _handoff("placed object not visible", label=label, uv=uv2, vp=vp)
    res["verify"] = ver
    err = np.array(ver["aabb_center"][:2], float) - np.array(target_xy, float)
    res["err_xy"] = err.tolist()
    res["placed_lo"] = ver["lo"].tolist(); res["placed_hi"] = ver["hi"].tolist()
    if float(np.max(np.abs(err))) > tol:
        _handoff("placement outside tolerance", label=label, err=err.tolist(), tol=tol,
                 placed=ver["aabb_center"].tolist(), target=list(target_xy))
    return res
